name: Mamahaha Choukyou
source:
Main character's father remarries on the school teacher, the protagonist's first love. He can not forgive her, and thus develops her strict training.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的初戀對象是學校的老師，如今竟然成了父親再婚的對象。他無法原諒她，決定對她展開嚴厲的調教。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
